notes.title: Holiday Update is now available
notes.content:
Missing white christmas? Forget reality and check out our brand new post-apocalyptic winter map with damaged ancient Chinese and USSR mecha warriors in a wonderfully combat-driven Christmas environment! 

[previewyoutube=YIqbzcj5kpA;full][/previewyoutube]

All of you who suffer from annoying christmas background music overdose enjoy our special gift: jingle bells era is now officially over. We turned Tank Maniacs main theme into a Christmas themed masterpiece. Be the first to hear!


Changelog


 Brand new post-apocalyptic winter map with damaged ancient Chinese and USSR mecha warriors in a wonderfully combat-driven Christmas environment!
 Minor Christmas-themed asset updates (tanks, pickups and many more!)
 Santa’s crew got oily while working in the tank factory. They even changed the background music. Thankfully it is not like one of the well-known shopping mall Christmas hits.


Known issues

 Sometimes layer opacity behaves unexpectedly with the showrunner’s plane.
 Issues with XBox One controllers connected after the game started
 Weird winning scores when a bot match is sped up
 Sometimes on Swamp, the Alligator just does not want to stop biting


Join the community! If you are searching for a friend to play with, or you just would like to give feedback to the developers, make sure to join our official Discord server at http://discord.gg/tankmaniacs!

notes.title: Tank Maniacs is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Dearest Fans! 

We are very excited to share this precious historical moment with you all! For an entire year our team has been putting all of its energy, knowledge and enthusiasm into developing the world’s (probably) best couch party game. You are on the right page, cause TM is the one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34964704/e8c0bb099248b50739dfe5efa8f7f889924d9881.jpg

Fun fact: it all started in a garage. Ok, no. But really, the whole idea of The Game was born while having fun at one of our regular game jams at Gamelab, our indie game developer studio. The first playable version of Tank Maniacs was put together in not more than 3 awesome days, by a bunch of awesome guys, and we enjoyed the game so much that kinda thought: hey, why not put all 20 of us on the project and spend an entire year eating only pizza out of boxes, getting fat, working on weekends and sleeping in the office just to add some extra good stuff for other geeks like us... Ok ok. We’re actually not fat, have regular workouts in the gym, respect weekends, but we’re sure so much in love with our work and our game, that any of the above would almost worth it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1046630/Tank_Maniacs/

So, releasing Tank Maniacs is the first real significant milestone in Gamelab’s history. And you’re here to see The Day. Enjoy! And be one of the firsts to buy the game. Thank you for becoming an obsessed TMaddict. We promise to commit everything to slowly overdose you with the most irresistible updates. 

Main features
 Couch madness for up to 4 players
 8 beautiful levels with unique features
 11 wonderfully weird tanks (including the Thanksgiving “Turkey Tank”)!
 12 wacky characters
 4 game modes + team based variations
 Dynamic commentary
 Unforgiving AI bots
 Twitch integration with in-game voting
 Fun, cartoony art style with hand-drawn graphics
 Punchy electro-rock soundtrack


[previewyoutube=XBgk9bTy80Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Twitch Extension
When you already think it’s too much of the good news we just have an ultimate one: the Twitch update is also available! Oh that’s great but what the f… is Twitch mode? So with the twitch extension your audience can interfere in the game while you’re streaming it. They will be able to vote on various different events, and create some beautiful chaos!

[previewyoutube=7K4NtIOnPAE;full][/previewyoutube]
Steam Remote Play
Tank Maniacs was born to be enjoyed by your friends on your side, so you can laugh in their faces when you beat them. But thanks to Steam Remote Play Together, you can play together even if you're hundreds of miles apart. Just make sure you still make fun of the guy with the poop rank at the end!

BUY NOW

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1046630/Tank_Maniacs/

notes.title: New York update v0.9.3.
notes.content:
We just can’t stop spoiling you… It’s not even Xmas and we already added 4 absolutely new game modes: the Gameshow and the Symmetric Showdown and both their team versions,  not to mention a completely new map, called New York, we guess even just reading the name you already envision something completely different from the earlier maps, and so it is, and oh,  wait…  you know what has changed to be even more user friendly and awesome? The Menu! What else do you want? Now you name it! Actually now you can, because guess what, you can set your own nickname after you pick your pilot. And lots of other new stuff so just run through and read it anyways. Get on with it, get spoiled. Santa’s almost here, soooo... wishlist now! 

Game modes 

We have 4 new game modes!

 Gameshow

In the Gameshow mode players will have to pay attention to another threat! From time to time, the “UH-1 Good Looking” appears and  chooses a random tank. In case it’s you, you better run because a Holy Hand Grenade (among many other things) could be the one that ends your career. 

 Team Gameshow

This is the same as the Gameshow mode, but you can team up with your friend and fight against another team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34964704/d14531521529daec875a5d7aa6b22de33b3538e4.jpg

 Symmetric Showdown

We have always wondered what happens when everybody drives the same tank. In the Symmetric Showdown all players get the same tank and once in a while it’ll change randomly. Beware! Your health remains on the same level!

 Team Symmetric Showdown

This is the same as the Symmetric Showdown mode, but you can team up with your friend and fight against another team.

Maps

 A new map, called New York is now available



Added features:

 Now you can set your own nickname after you choose your character
 If you’ve run out of lives during a match now you can still influence the gameplay


Changed:

 We have a new menu design
 The airplane is now following a random path every time it appears 
 Now we fill up the empty spaces with bots automatically (you can still change the quantity)
 We have reworked the following maps:
 Bridge Ruins
 Rolling Stones
 Swamp
 We’ve changed a lot of other things under the hood


Currently not available:

 The Chicken Tank
 The Catapult Tank
 Tutorial
 Maps: Down Hill, Trampoline 2, Volcano holo maps
 Bot matches are temporarily turned off

notes.title: Free Demo for Tank Maniacs is live now

What’s the only thing that could beat the good news that Tank Maniacs is almost ready to be published? Of course the even better news: we made a demo for our fans! Certainly we can still beat the good and even better news: our demo is FREE and available from 05/11 till 17/11! Too bad we can’t see your faces now. But maybe not too bad after all.

So if you’re up to the game all you have to do now is to gather 3 of your best friends or any available family members, or just let’s say less obnoxious classmates, but maybe simply random people in your dorm who are still willing to talk to you will do, so the 4 of you can now occupy the couch and start the battle! But of course if humans in your reach are scarce or you prefer your own company over all other creatures’, we have charming AI bots to beat you. You’re welcome.

notes.title: Daily Public Test Realm Builds
notes.content:
We have a brand new challenge for our most dedicated beta pilots. 

The Tank Maniacs Crew works tirelessly to release updates as frequently as humanly possible. But what if we told you that from now on you don’t have to wait a whole week to break the game?

That’s right, now you can opt-in to our highly exclusive PTR Steam branch and receive DAILY updates! Of course this comes at a cost: this process is totally automated and you WILL receive incomplete features that are actively being worked on. There is no guarantee that the game in this state is going to be stable, so please keep this in mind as you hammer your keyboard to report issues.

To do so simply right click on Tank Maniacs in your Steam library and select 'Properties'. On the 'BETAS' tab change the dropdown to 'ptr_daily - Public Test Realm daily build' and you are set to go.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34964704/1b8cdd4b80847f05ca6cf37cf41ce2dc7ee39a38.png

notes.title: Controller App Release Announcement
notes.content:
Turn your phone or tablet into a full-blown touch controller for Tank Maniacs!

We have realised that not everyone has four gamepads at home. Or not even one, and may not even be at home when the opportunity comes to play a party game with friends! But as we all know since last November: gamers have phones! This is why we have developed a controller application for our couch party game. 

Download "TANK MANIACS CONTROLLER” to your phone and you will have your controller with you, anywhere you go, anytime you are up for a game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34964704/7f716776430372798705bd00a73edc23ff513215.png

Of course, the app won’t completely replace an ergonomic gamepad and since it is network-based there is a slight input lag. We have tested it at office and gaming event conditions and we think it is a viable alternative that can provide additional features in the future.


 Android Play Store
 iOS App Store


But how does it work? It is as easy as driving a tank. You probably have a WiFi router at home right? If not, we have some bad news for you. Once you’ve found out what’s going on with your home internet, tell your friends that they need to connect with their phones to your WiFi network. The PC or Laptop should also be on the same network that you are using for running the game. If you are all on the same network, simply launch the Controller App while the game is running, and press Join. That’s all, you are ready to roll out. 

Oh and one more thing. You can mix up the controllers, so you can use different ones in the same time - for e.g. one keyboard with 2 phones and one Xbox One controller etc. it doesn’t matter. Try out the game with your old budget controller that you’ve bought for 1$, we probably support that as well.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34964704/7fb15ba1589db9d1e16d596ce1e1366577ce2044.jpg

Please send your feedback to support@tankmaniacs.com or join our Discord server at https://discord.gg/tankmaniacs

notes.title: Holo Map Update v0.1.2

Our first Steam Closed Beta update introduces a crazy new tank and some fresh maps!

We call them holo maps. These are levels still under construction. The environmental aesthetics are temporary placeholders.
